tara: quick heads-up: canary for hera-liteq int4 shows elevated toolcall v3 parse failures (~2.4%). short sample attached.
ben: I checked logs, many traces end with a NUL (\u0000) or truncated suffix '...'. looks like streaming chunk boundary issue.
mohit: repro snippet: ```{"action":"search","args":{"q":"runtime kernels"},�```
sara: pattern only when streaming=true and kv_reuse=true on int4. disabling streaming drops failures by ~80%.
ben: canary-bot please run matrix: variants=[int4,int8,fp32], streaming=[true,false], kernel=[A,B], sample=500
canary-bot: job 9998 queued. will post summary when done. :hourglass:
mohit: mitigation idea: append a private-use sentinel before streaming and strip in postprocess for canary only. that will help detect truncation reliably.
sara: agree. also add token-offset probe for failing traces (last 48 token ids). we need to know if NUL comes from tokenizer or buffer.
tara: I'll push sentinel + probe to canary route and enable opt-in. if job shows int4+streaming+kernelA spike, prioritize kernelA streaming assembly fix.
ben: also add CI gate: block auto-rollout if parse_fail_rate > 0.5% on toolcall-v3 for new quant variants.
mohit: noted. will follow up with a short runbook and PR for sentinel probe.
tara: thanks, team. will paste bisect results when canary-bot returns.
